notes: win-c-clear-skill builtin whitelist. Editable per machine. Paths MUST use environment variables (%LOCALAPPDATA%/%APPDATA%/%USERPROFILE%/%TEMP%/%ProgramData%/%WinDir%/%ProgramFiles%) for portability. mergeSources points to the bundled assets/rules (relative to this file). externalMergeSources is optional: add ABSOLUTE paths to a local rule-source directory if you have one; leave empty for portable/GitHub use.

targets.name: WPS office6 backup (document backups)

targets.name: TeX Live install tree
targets.risk: Removes TeX Live. Prefer migrate/junction, not blind delete. Requires explicit multi-step confirmation.

targets.name: hiberfil.sys (hibernation file)
targets.risk: Disables hibernation/fast startup via powercfg (native, clean removal) and frees the hiberfil.sys file (often 6-20 GB). Re-enable later with 'powercfg /h on'. Direct file deletion is blocked by the engine guardrail; only the powercfg path is used.

targets.name: Windows Event Logs (Application/System/Setup)
targets.risk: Clears the Application/System/Setup event logs via the native wevtutil command (BleachBit-style). Diagnostics history is lost; logs rebuild automatically as events occur. Never deletes the .evtx files directly.

targets.name: Windows Security Event Log (audit trail)
targets.risk: Clears the Security audit log via native wevtutil. Login/privilege-use audit trail is permanently lost (may be required for compliance forensics). Two-phase confirmation required.

targets.name: Defender scan history
targets.risk: Defender detection history (BleachBit windows_defender cleaner). Past detections list is cleared; quarantine entries may become unreferenced. Scans themselves are unaffected.

targets.name: Defender support logs
targets.risk: Defender runtime/support logs only; regenerate during normal operation.

targets.name: Windows.old (previous installation)
targets.risk: Removes the previous Windows installation tree. You lose the ability to roll back to the old OS version, and old user profile files under Windows.old are gone forever. Often 10-30 GB. Alternative: Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files, or Disk Cleanup (cleanmgr) 'Previous Windows installation(s)'. Two-phase confirmation required; engine runs takeown/icacls then deletes.

targets.name: pagefile.sys / swapfile.sys (ADVISORY ONLY)
targets.risk: ADVISORY-ONLY: the engine never deletes these files (deleting a live pagefile corrupts the running system). This target only reports their sizes and explains options: move pagefile to another drive via System Properties > Advanced > Virtual Memory (sysdm.cpl), or disable it (not recommended below 32 GB RAM). Even with explicit confirmation the engine returns status=advisory with instructions instead of touching the files.

targets.name: WindowsUpdate.log
targets.risk: Legacy Windows Update text log; current logs live in Event Log/ETL. Safe to remove.

targets.name: Windows setup logs (Panther)
targets.risk: OS setup/upgrade migration logs. Keep if you are still troubleshooting an upgrade; otherwise disposable.

targets.name: Device setup logs (setupapi*.log)
targets.risk: BLOCKED BY ENGINE GUARDRAIL: %WinDir%\inf is a protected path (driver INF store), so this target always returns blocked-by-guardrail and deletes nothing. Kept for documentation only; clear setupapi logs via Disk Cleanup if needed.

targets.name: Windows font cache
targets.risk: Font cache service database; rebuilds automatically after service restart (BleachBit system cleaner). First app launches may be marginally slower.

targets.name: Explorer icon cache (IconCache*.db)
targets.risk: Explorer icon cache databases; rebuild automatically. Only IconCache*.db files at %LOCALAPPDATA% root are matched.

targets.name: BranchCache cache
targets.risk: BranchCache peer content cache; re-fetches from origin when next needed.

targets.name: UWP app TempState (all packages)
targets.risk: Per-app temporary state for packaged (Store/UWP) apps; apps recreate as needed. Wildcard across all packages.

targets.name: UWP WebView INetCache (all packages)
targets.risk: Embedded WebView internet cache for packaged apps; regenerable.

targets.name: UWP app LocalCache (all packages)
targets.risk: App-managed cache area; some apps store real data here (not just caches). Disabled by default; review per-app before enabling.

targets.name: Visual Studio ComponentModelCache
targets.risk: VS MEF component cache; rebuilds on next VS start (first start slightly slower). Wildcard across VS versions.

targets.name: JetBrains IDE caches (all products)
targets.risk: Index/compile caches for IntelliJ-family IDEs; indexes rebuild on next open. Wildcard across products/versions.

targets.name: Teams (classic) caches
targets.risk: Classic Teams Electron caches; chat data is server-side.

targets.name: OneDrive logs
targets.risk: OneDrive sync client logs; sync content unaffected.

targets.name: Edge Update logs
targets.risk: Edge updater diagnostic logs.

targets.name: NuGet plugins cache
targets.risk: NuGet plugin download cache; re-downloads when needed.

targets.name: PowerShell transcripts (Documents)
targets.risk: Session transcripts if Start-Transcript logging is enabled. Disabled by default: may serve as audit records.
